author: Classical_freaK
body:
https://plus.google.com/110986364757334168162/posts/W7sT1Lzi9Lh Hello, all!

I'm no map builder, but I would love to make one, just one, that would deliver exactly what I love from Nebula. There are a couple things that I really can get into in a good Nebula map:

Simple, easy-access maps for intense game play (take, for example: Rendezvous I, Sandstorm, Quintus, the like);
Certain in-game buffs that enhance game play and make for exciting matches (before the update, there were Fire Aspect II bows in Senex. This made any team who owned them able to recreate a soaring hell for the other team!);
Many monuments so that it isn't just one go-getter ending the round 30 seconds in.

Well what if I create a map that delivers on that, but changes something? Here's an odd idea:
Let's say that there are two teams, for now RED and BLUE. RED team is on a floating island, as is BLUE, but they aren't equal-sized islands (See the diagram). RED is obviously at a disadvantage because the BLUE area surrounds it partially. But here's the kicker: RED is given buffs that BLUE hasn't, just as BLUE has some benefits. Say, RED is given Knockback bows, or Strength potions, while BLUE has Speed or something. I really haven't too many ideas, I would love feedback, positive or negative. The idea is that land-wise, yes, the teams are definitely partial to BLUE, but once you add in buffs of some sort, RED is just as powerful as BLUE is.

KEY
Red/Blue lines for spawn areas
Filled-in circles for spawn-points
Black boxes are monuments, A B C and D
Light gray is possible places for the teams to access the monuments easier.
